name: One Runemaster Etching per caster, and one of each Etching type, on each recipient (#4039)
contract: The Runemaster ally buffs are three Etchings with a single-target and a party version each (SpellFamilyName 38): Etching of the Dextrous 561237 (Agility, ranks 561238-561240) and Greater Etching of the Dextrous 561241, Etching of the Leylines 561236 and Greater 561242 (total stats %, aura 137), Etching of the Magi 560295 and Greater 561243 (cost reduction, aura 72). No spell_group listed them, so one Runemaster could keep all of them on a target. #4039 reports that casting one should remove the other, 'like paladin buff': a second Runemaster is needed for a second Etching. This mirrors the Witch Hunter Edicts (group 1139, stack rule 2): the six Etchings share group 1140 with SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER, and each Etching and its Greater version share a rule 1 group (1042-1044) so the same buff from two casters does not stack either. Expected: a Runemaster's second Etching replaces its first, another Runemaster's different Etching coexists, and another Runemaster's same Etching replaces the first one's.

steps.label: Etching of the Leylines on self
Etching of the Leylines is applied
Etching of the Dextrous from the same caster
Etching of the Dextrous is applied

The other caster's different Etching coexists

The second Runemaster gives Etching of the Dextrous
The other caster's Etching of the Dextrous is applied
It replaced the same buff from the first caster
